verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships its own typedoc API reference (e.g., the BABYLON.NullEngine class page) and a first-party interactive Playground code editor with sharing. That covers both an API reference and runnable examples. The evidence does not show the reference pages themselves being interactive or linking to runnable Playground examples. Missing for 10: documented integration of runnable examples within API reference pages, evidence that the reference is interactive, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference-plus-examples workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
